purpose: Teach: あらわす/すすめる/雇う/建つ/散る/知ろ/ずばり/いちど

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きで気持ちをあらわすのは素敵ね
lines.en: Sho, expressing your feelings through drawing is really lovely.
lines.style: Warm, affirming tone. Gentle attention on the boy. Slight smile in the voice. A moment of tender noticing — she sees what he's doing and values it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お友達にお絵描きをすすめるよ
lines.en: Mom, I want to tell my friends about drawing too.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. A small boy's voice, thoughtful rather than excited. He's connecting something he's learned to wanting to share it. Slight lift at the end — seeking approval.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのお店はパートさんを雇うのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is hiring some part-time staff at the store.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but gentle. A practical update offered without fanfare. There's something in the tone that suggests she's checking in with him about changes — noticing he pays attention to these things.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お家の隣に新しい家が建つみたいだよ
lines.en: Mom, I think a new house is being built next to ours.
lines.style: Observant, eager to share. A small boy reporting something he's noticed. The discovery in his voice — he's looking at the world around him. Slight brightness, wanting to tell her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お庭の桜の花びらが散る季節ね
lines.en: Sho, the cherry blossoms in the garden are falling now — it's that time of year.
lines.style: Reflective, almost meditative. She's pointing something out gently. Quiet attention on the seasonal change. The tone carries both beauty and transience — a moment she's inviting him to see with her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんに会って、もっと知ろうって思ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I met Grandpa and now I want to understand him better.
lines.style: Soft, sincere determination. A small boy thinking about an older person. The words carry something serious underneath — not just curiosity, but connection. Steady pace, genuine in the wanting.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ずばり言うと、お父さんは絵が苦手なのよ
lines.en: Sho, to be frank — your dad is actually not very good at drawing.
lines.style: Dry humor, affectionate wryness. A small laugh underneath the words. She's deflating pretense with gentle honesty, and the warmth says she's doing it with love. The dad doesn't need to be perfect.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、いちどお祖父ちゃんに料理を習いたい
lines.en: Mom, I'd like to learn how to cook from Grandpa sometime.
lines.style: Soft, deliberate wanting. A small boy's voice carrying a quiet request. The word 'sometime' holds possibility — not urgent, but real intention. Close, intimate, speaking directly to his mother.
